title: The first tunes: Fandango and Mother Pin a Rose on Me
summary: She did not know what she was playing as a baby; later she played a ragtime tune her mother taught her, 'Fandango', and a song her stepfather Fletcher Burley taught her.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When you started picking out those tunes on your mother's lap, do you know now what you were doing?
No, that's the strange thing, I didn't know what I was doing.
I mean do you know the tunes now? Did your mother tell you?

No, when I played the History of Jazz I played the same tune that she taught me... it was a rag-time. we called it 'Fandango' And "Mother Pin a Rose on Me", my stepfather taught me that when I was - I used to play that.
This was, when you talk of your stepfather, Fletcher Burley?
